lines.lyric_translation: I do what I want

lines.lyric: Mweol hageona malgeona shwigeona we gonna
lines.lyric_hangul: 뭘 하거나 말거나 쉬거나 we gonna
lines.lyric_translation: Whatever I do or don’t or I just take a rest we gonna
I go with my gut

lines.lyric: Shwibge da kkaengpan chigoseo daeum pan
lines.lyric_hangul: 쉽게 다 깽판 치고서 다음 판
lines.lyric_translation: I win easily and move on to the next round
I’ll beat them all everyone and get to the top

lines.lyric: Mweo naekineun daero nune boineun geollo
lines.lyric_hangul: 뭐 내키는 대로 눈에 보이는 걸로
lines.lyric_translation: I do what I want, I take whatever I see

lines.lyric: Haji mweoreul haedo naegen joa boigo
lines.lyric_hangul: 하지 뭐를 해도 내겐 좋아 보이고
lines.lyric_translation: Whatever I do, it looks good to me

lines.lyric: Naega goreun geose huhwe ttawin eopseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 고른 것에 후회 따윈 없어
lines.lyric_translation: I don’t regret my decisions

lines.lyric: Gyang dakchineun daero golla gaji let it flow
lines.lyric_hangul: 걍 닥치는 대로 골라 가지 let it flow
lines.lyric_translation: I pick out anything in my reach and go let it flow
North, South, East, West, I crush them all

lines.lyric: I don’t care eojjeorago gyang maiweiyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: I don't care 어쩌라고 걍 마이웨이여
lines.lyric_translation: I don’t care, or what? This is my own way

lines.lyric: Chaenggil mulgeon eopshi lose your mind
lines.lyric_hangul: 챙길 물건 없이 lose your mind
lines.lyric_translation: Without packing things, lose your mind
Whatever people say, so what
Let go of everything and have fun, eat and have fun

lines.lyric: Eotteon mari ogadeunji live your life
lines.lyric_hangul: 어떤 말이 오가든지 live your life
lines.lyric_translation: No matter what people say, live your life

lines.lyric: Yeah mweodeun jechyeobeoryeo da knock out machi
lines.lyric_hangul: Yeah 뭐든 제쳐버려 다 knock out 마치
lines.lyric_translation: Yeah put everything aside knock out like

lines.lyric: Neukkimi ganeun daero play it now machi
lines.lyric_hangul: 느낌이 가는 대로 play it now 마치
lines.lyric_translation: Whatever I feel like doing play it now like
Everything looks so easy

I make you say wow
Whatever I do or don’t, however I live
Look at me now
I turn things upside down
I make you say wow
Whether I throw the first punch or bust it all
Look at me now
I sweep everything away

I followed the wind

lines.lyric_hangul: 원한 대로 말한 대로 다 돼 이렇게
